notes: Copes start AT the bar end. A cope whose wire touches the X=0 or X=-L plane is meant to start on that edge and cut inward, but the rule was assumed rather than enforced - two copes on the same face could disagree, one starting on the edge and the next finishing there. Starting at an edge pierces into fresh air at the bar end instead of into solid plate. Approach and retract within a face are now L moves, not J: a joint move interpolates in joint space, so the tool bows between poses - fine in free space, and straight through the web when hopping from one cope to the next. Only the move that gets the torch ONTO a face stays a joint move, and these now obey the Rapid speed setting. Both change generated output, so regenerate and check a program before cutting.
